result_text:
The "Undefined Team" remainder now only collects active contributors.

**Change:** in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`, in `getAllTeams()` (around line 747), the remainder condition now also requires `contributor.getContributor().isActive()`. Unmatched dormant contributors are skipped; configured teams are untouched.

**Blank dates:** no extra code was needed. `Contributor.isActive()` calls `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange`, which returns `true` for a blank date, so contributors with missing data stay in the remainder.

**Verification:** `mvn -o -pl codeanalyzer test` builds successfully. No existing tests cover `LandscapeAnalysisResults` or `TeamsConfig`, so no test exercised the new condition. I did not add a test for it.

Nothing was committed.
